messages:
sandeep: paging: getting alerts for elevated 5xx rate across eu-west-1 -> eu-north routing pair. Customer-impacting: AcmeCorp latency/timeouts on chat completions. Root symptoms look like repeated region fallbacks + cache hits for wrong variant.
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 created (1918765432) — smart-routing fallback LOOP detected. Pager notified: @oncall-sre. See /incidents/1918765432.
oncall-sre: picking this up, I’m on call. Can someone paste current routing policy hash and whether we rolled the canary last night?
maya: we rolled route-policy v3.4.1 at 00:22 UTC (canary -> 50%) for cheaper eu routing. It changes variant selection to prefer small-quant models in overcapacity.
sandeep: logs show a mismatch in the KV prefix keying: kv_cache_key = model_name + region in runtime, but the router caches by model_variant + traffic_region in policy. That led to eu-west requests hitting cached KV from eu-north variant (different tokenizer/kv shapes) -> decoding errors and spurious fallback decisions.
ellie: confirmed in traces: sample request id 0a3b shows router sent to variant small-quant-eu-north, runtime pulled KV entry for small-quant-eu-west -> outputs garbled -> router marks as degraded and falls back to eu-north again -> loop.
support-desk: we have 8 customer reports (AcmeCorp & BetaLabs), app-level timeouts ~30s, errors 502/504. Sending customer comms: "we’re investigating; temporary mitigation in progress".
oncall-sre: triage plan: 1) pause routing policy v3.4.1 canary (flip to v3.4.0), 2) disable prefix-kv cache for affected shards, 3) evict stale KV keys for model small-quant.
sandeep: working on canary rollback now. Running:
```bash
# disable canary
redwoodctl routing policy set --name smart-fallback --version 3.4.0 --force
```
maya: starting KV eviction job for prefix "small-quant/eu-*" across shards. Doing gradual evict to avoid thundering herd. Command:
```bash
redis-cli -h kv-shard-7 --scan --pattern "small-quant:*|eu-*" | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h kv-shard-7 del
```
incident-bot: Pager escalation policy triggered: paging ops-lead in 10m if no progress.
ops-lead: on my way, if rollback completes, we should monitor tail latencies and token error rates. Also add a temporary routing rule to prefer region-local variant strictly (no cross-region reuse) until we verify keying.
ellie: deployed a temporary feature-flag: router.strict_local_variant=true for eu clusters. It will force variant selection to include region tag in the routing decision and skip cached fallback variant mapping.
oncall-sre: rollback applied (smart-fallback -> 3.4.0). Confirming metrics: 5xx rate dropping from 8.2% -> 2.1% at proxy layer in last 3m.
sandeep: KV eviction in progress; shard 3/8 done. We’re pacing deletes to 500/s. Early logs show decoding errors dropping.
support-desk: updated AcmeCorp with ETA ~15m, asked to validate. BetaLabs acknowledged and will monitor.
ellie: added temporary alert suppressions for noisier fallback flaps to avoid alert fatigue, but left P1 page active until stable for 30m.
oncall-sre: monitoring shows residual errors for a small subset of long-tail keys; will run a targeted full-scan for model small-quant-legacy.
maya: found one config bug: when building cache keys, the runtime used region tag 'eu' (coarse) while routing policy used 'eu-west-1' (full). That mismatch caused collisions when fallback mapped to 'eu-north-1'. Fix PR open: https://git.redwood/repo/routing/PR-429.
sandeep: putting the PR as hotfix for release after this incident. Test plan: unit test key normalization and an end-to-end with fake routing.
ops-lead: mitigation summary to execs: paused canary (v3.4.1), evicted mismatched KV prefixes, enabled strict_local_variant, and hotfix PR opened. No customer data exposure. Primary customer impact: degraded completions for two enterprise customers, transient latency spikes, and 80 total failed requests observed.
oncall-sre: closing notes — metrics stable: proxy 5xx at 0.4% now, user-facing timeouts back to baseline. Will keep monitoring for 2 hours.
incident-bot: INCIDENT P1 auto-update: status -> mitigation in progress.
ellie: followups: 1) postmortem with RCA and timeline, 2) add unit/integration tests for cache-key normalization, 3) extend canary rollout gating to include KV-key churn metrics, 4) run a full key consistency scan weekly.
sandeep: action items assigned: I’ll own the hotfix PR and tests, Maya will own KV-eviction automation, Ellie will update runbook and gating, Support will draft customer post-incident note.
support-desk: drafting note now. Ping me when metrics are green and we’ll send customers final update. :white_check_mark:
ops-lead: thanks @team — handing to on-call follow-up for 2h monitoring. If anything re-escalates, re-open pager. :thumbsup:
